_note: Village NPCs (HI-3, journals/human_island_journal.md). Tuning per kind: `speed` px/s, `idle` seconds between walks (min, max), `leash` tiles from home a wander target may stray (a sheep's is clamped to its pen as well), `radius` px for the walkability probe. `rigs` name the character rigs by colour; `work` is the smith's one-shot flourish (chance per idle). A kind with `aggro` fights: it charges an enemy within `aggro` tiles at `charge` px/s, keeps within `chase` tiles of home, thrusts for `damage` when the foe's edge is inside `reach` px (landing on `hit_frame` of the attack strip, `cooldown` s apart, pushing `knock` through the weight split at `weight`) and walks back when the foe dies or gets away. Counts per village are the placement's (`lancers` is the garrison, dealt round the guard posts); colours are drawn per NPC from a shuffled cycle, never one colour per village.
